h1: Cabana Lipe Beach Resort — Beachfront Rooms on Sunrise Beach Where Breakfast Comes to Your Balcony
intro: On the sunrise side of Koh Lipe, Cabana Lipe Beach Resort is a small Thai-style boutique resort that guests keep returning to for one reason — you open your door to the sea in the morning, and breakfast is brought to your balcony at the time you asked for it · a 3-star, 28-room beachfront resort opened in 2016, every room with a private balcony or patio, a short walk to the island's Walking Street · rates start at around ฿2,800/night for a standard room, making it a fitting choice when you want a quiet beachfront room at a price that's still within reach.

Room balcony set with a delivered breakfast, looking out over clear water
White-sand, clear-water Sunrise Beach in front of Cabana Lipe, quiet and calm

body.html: Sunrise Beach is the stretch many travellers rate as the prettiest and quietest on Koh Lipe — fine white sand, water clear enough to spot coral, and far less foot traffic than Pattaya Beach · Cabana Lipe sits directly on it, with the sea coming up to the resort wall at times · this is the first thing nearly every review mentions: a beachfront location on the sunrise side where you can watch the sun come up from your own balcony.

What sets Cabana apart from other resorts on the same beach is breakfast served to your room balcony at the time you arrange · no walking to a dining room — you sit at your private table over the sea and staff bring the breakfast set to you, with cooked items, fruit, yoghurt and drinks · it's a small touch guests mention often, and it makes the stay feel more special than the price suggests · worth knowing: there's no central restaurant and no swimming pool here, the focus is squarely on the beachfront rooms and the beach itself.
"Opened the curtains in the morning to the sunrise sea right there, and breakfast arrived on the balcony right on time — the best morning of the trip."

There are 28 rooms, every one with a private balcony or patio · the entry tiers are the Superior Double and Deluxe Room at around 36–40 sqm, larger than you'd expect for an island resort · stepping up, the Deluxe Partial Sea View gives a partial view of the water, and the top Deluxe Ocean Facing looks straight out to sea · rooms are simple, clean Thai-style with Egyptian-cotton sheets, a fridge and minibar · many reviews praise the clean rooms and daily housekeeping, though a few show some wear, so check the photos for the exact tier you book.

Location is another key advantage · it's a short walk to Walking Street, the island's central lane lined with restaurants, mini-marts, tour desks and dive shops · the walking score is very high, with dozens of restaurants within easy reach · there's snorkelling off the beach out front, on-site massage, and help arranging boat tours and ferry tickets · staff earn praise for being friendly and accommodating, especially with timing the balcony breakfast and with pier transfers.

To be straight with you, Cabana isn't a resort with every facility · the recurring note in reviews is no pool and no central restaurant, so you head out to Walking Street for other meals · the entrance runs through a local residential area that looks ordinary rather than polished · there's some noise from taxi boats and the surrounding community, the showers run warm rather than piping hot, and mosquitoes around the breakfast area get a mention · this is a resort that stands out for its beachfront rooms and warm service rather than for a full slate of facilities like a big resort.

The takeaway from real guest reviews: if you're coming to Koh Lipe to focus on the sea, the quiet, and a beachfront room on Sunrise Beach with attentive service, Cabana fits beautifully — especially for couples or anyone who wants to wake up to breakfast on a quiet balcony · but if you want a pool, an on-site restaurant or a full set of facilities, look one tier up · the trick is to book a Sea View or Ocean Facing room to make staying on this beach worthwhile, and time your breakfast for sunrise.

honestSummary: Cabana Lipe Beach Resort is a Sunrise Beach stay that stands out for its beachfront rooms, the quiet, and breakfast served to your balcony — ideal for couples and anyone who wants to wake up to the sea in a calm setting with warm service · but accept that there's no pool and no central restaurant, with fewer facilities than a big resort, so it fits when you're here for the sea and privacy rather than a full slate of amenities.
honestChecks: If you want a swimming pool or an on-site restaurant — Cabana has neither, so other meals mean a walk to Walking Street → choose a resort with a pool and restaurant on the island instead.
If you're paying to be on the beach but book an entry tier — some rooms have only a partial sea view → upgrade to a Deluxe Partial Sea View or Deluxe Ocean Facing to make this beach worthwhile.
If you're planning the low season (May–Oct) — Koh Lipe's monsoon is strong, many places close and ferries run less → confirm the resort is open and check the boat schedule before you book.

tips.title: Time breakfast for sunrise
tips.body: The standout is breakfast served to your balcony. Arrange it for when the sun rises over Sunrise Beach for the prettiest morning of your trip.

tips.title: Upgrade to a sea-view room
tips.body: If you're staying on the beach, pick a Deluxe Partial Sea View or Ocean Facing — it's worth more than an entry room with only a partial view of the water.

tips.title: Plan other meals at Walking Street
tips.body: The resort has no central restaurant. For lunch and dinner, walk to the nearby Walking Street, with dozens of restaurants and seafood spots to choose from.

tips.title: Avoid low season, check the boat schedule
tips.body: Best time is Nov–Apr with calm, clear seas. The rainy season (May–Oct) brings strong monsoon, many places close and ferries run less — always check first.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Cabana Lipe Beach Resort

faq.q: Where is Cabana Lipe Beach Resort and how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits right on Sunrise Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun Province · about a 5-minute walk to the island's central Walking Street · to reach Koh Lipe you take a boat from Pak Bara Pier (Satun) or a pier in a nearby province, then a longtail to the beach · the resort can arrange ferry tickets and pier transfers — ask in advance.

faq.q: What are Cabana Lipe's starting rates and room types?
faq.a: From around ฿2,800/night for a Superior Double Room · Deluxe Room about ฿3,200 · Deluxe Partial Sea View about ฿3,800 · and the top Deluxe Ocean Facing (full sea view) about ฿4,800 · rates swing by season and climb at peak, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What makes Cabana Lipe special compared with other resorts on the same beach?
faq.a: The feature guests mention most is breakfast served to your room balcony at the time you arrange · no walking to a dining room — you take in the sunrise sea from your private balcony and staff bring the breakfast set to you · combined with a quiet Sunrise Beach location and warm service, it's why many couples return.

faq.q: Does Cabana Lipe have a pool and a restaurant?
faq.a: There's no swimming pool and no central restaurant on site · for lunch and dinner you walk to the nearby Walking Street, with dozens of restaurants and seafood spots · only breakfast is served, to your balcony · if you want a pool and restaurant on site, look at a higher-tier stay on the island.

faq.q: Who is Cabana Lipe best for?
faq.a: Best for couples and travellers focused on the sea, the quiet, and a beachfront room with attentive service · the Sunrise Beach location is calm and you can watch the sunrise from your balcony · if you're a family wanting a pool or a full set of facilities, a larger resort on the island may suit you better.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Cabana Lipe?
faq.a: Best is November to April with calm, clear seas and clear skies · the rainy season (May–Oct) brings strong monsoon, many island places close and ferries run less often, so always confirm the resort is open and check the boat schedule before booking.
